coordinates.title: Marrow Keep
coordinates.description: After finishing the Prologue, this area will be your main base.

coordinates.title: Widow Overlook
coordinates.description: This is one of the first activated beacons when you exit the Marrow Keep for the first time.

coordinates.title: Corrupted Statue - Widow’s Overlook
coordinates.description: This corrupted statue can be found north of the Widow's Overlook Beacon.

coordinates.title: Martyr’s Tomb
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found inside an abandoned church overlooking the Great Arbiter of Flesh from a cliff.

coordinates.title: Shrine of Trials
coordinates.description: This dungeon can only be accessed by

coordinates.title: Mushroom Village
coordinates.description: This beacon can be found inside Mushroom Village. Near enemy mob and large bonfire.

coordinates.title: Corrupted Statue - Mushroom Village Gate
coordinates.description: This corrupted statue can be found north of the Mushroom Village Gate Beacon.

coordinates.title: Ritual Grounds
coordinates.description: This dungeon can be found south of the Mushroom Village, behind the house and gravestone where you find Tiel's Shell.

coordinates.title: Mushroom Village Gate
coordinates.description: This beacon can be found past the Mushroom Village beacon when you head east. This is also found just in front of the Gate leading to the Gutten Mire.

coordinates.title: Glutten Mire
coordinates.description: This gate is found behind the Mushroom Village Gate beacon. This also acts as a fast travel point for Mether's Breath allowing you to choose between Seeping Mire, Sunken Village, and Magdalena's Glade.

coordinates.title: Tiel, The Acolyte
coordinates.description: From the Widow's Overlook beacon, head southeast until you reach a fence structure with two torches at the entrance. Go inside, then turn left to access Tiel's corpse. You will receive the shell afterwards.

coordinates.title: Axe＆Dagger
coordinates.description: You can pick up the Axe & Dagger from the Shrine of Trials Dungeon near the Mushroom Village Beacon. This requires finding the Chapel Key to unlock the Dungeon.

coordinates.title: Outskirts of Mammon
coordinates.description: This is one of the first beacons you can travel to when you leave Marrow Keep for the first time.

coordinates.title: Acolyte’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Acolyte's Stone can be purchased from Merrick in the Marrow Keep.

coordinates.title: Unwieldly Stone
coordinates.description: The Unwieldly Stone can be purchased from Merrick in the Marrow Keep.

coordinates.title: Genessa, The Wayward
coordinates.description: To obtain Genessa, start by heading to the Revenant Graves and look for an area of foliage with red petals surrounded by Sesters. Look for the Sester's Censer and interact with it to be transported to a different area. Defeat Sester Secundus and Hand the Sester's Censer over to the Stray Sester in Meadow's Keep. Watch the memory play out, and you'll receive Genessa's shell.

coordinates.title: Corrupted Statue - Ritual Grounds
coordinates.description: This corrupted statue can be found inside the Ritual Grounds dungeon.

coordinates.title: Wounding Stone
coordinates.description: The Wounding Stone can be found in a chest near where you pick up the Shell of Tiel, the Acolyte.

coordinates.title: Chapel Key
coordinates.description: This key can be found on some rope near the dancing old ladies with the bonfire. Pass through the stone arch to see the statue holding the key.

coordinates.title: Map of Fainweald 【4】
coordinates.description: This map fragment can be found on an elevated platform south of the Widow's Overlook beacon and west of Tiel, the Acolyte's location.

coordinates.title: Obisidian Lathe
coordinates.description: This key item can be looted from the Martyr's Tomb, a dungeon found in a church past the Great Arbiter of Flesh in Widow's Overlook.

coordinates.title: Parasitic Stone
coordinates.description: The Parasitic Stone can be looted from the Martyr's Tomb, a dungeon found in a church past the Great Arbiter of Flesh in Widow's Overlook.

coordinates.title: Arbiter’s Prize
coordinates.description: The Arbiter's Prize is a loot drop from defeating the Great Arbiter of Flesh in Widow's Overlook.

coordinates.title: Emberseed Stone
coordinates.description: The Emberseed Stone is found in a chest inside the Mushroom Village Beacon in the Passenger's Shrine.

coordinates.title: One Legged Wolf
coordinates.description: This beacon is found north of the Mushroom Village Gate beacon just past the Corrupted Statue. You will need Mether's Breath to unlock the area leading to this.

coordinates.title: Retribution Stone
coordinates.description: The Retribution Stone is obtained as a reward for clearing the corrupted statue can be found north of the Widow's Overlook Beacon.

coordinates.title: Map of Fainweald 【5】
coordinates.description: This map fragment can be found near a rockwall just north of the One Legged Wolf beacon.

coordinates.title: Map of Fainweald 【3】
coordinates.description: This map fragment can be found near a cliff north of the Widow's Overlook beacon.

coordinates.title: Proxima, The Broodseeker
coordinates.description: Head northwest of the Blackridge Pass beacon. Find the area guarded by an Infested Stalker. Enter the beacon and  you will then find Proxima's corpse inside.

coordinates.title: Flooded Village
coordinates.description: This dungeon can be found north of the Widow's Overlook. Its entrance is hidden via enchantment. Pass through the stone arch to reveal the doorway.

coordinates.title: Forgotten Crossbow
coordinates.description: Accessible by opening the locked area with the damp key.

coordinates.title: Blackridge Pass Beacon
coordinates.description: This beacon is found north of the Widow's Overlook beacon and south of the Flooded Village Dungeon.

coordinates.title: Seeping Mire
coordinates.description: This beacon is found inside the Glutted Mire, an unmapped area behind the Mushroom Village Gate.

coordinates.title: Sunken Village
coordinates.description: This beacon is found inside the Glutted Mire, an unmapped area behind the Mushroom Village Gate.

coordinates.title: Corroded Stone
coordinates.description: The Corroded Stone can be found in a chest inside the Sunken Village Beacon in the Glutted Mire.

coordinates.title: Auspicious Stone
coordinates.description: Light the three candles as an offering to unlock the chest in the Mushroom Village to obtain the Auspicious Stone.

coordinates.title: Magdalena’s Memento
coordinates.description: The Magdalena's Memento is a loot drop from defeating Magdalena, Lady of the Woods.

coordinates.title: Marksman’s Stone
coordinates.description: Collect the Marksman's Stone from a chest past the Corrupted Statue near the Mushroom Village Gate Beacon.

coordinates.title: Siegebreaker’s Stone
coordinates.description: Light the three candles as an offering to unlock the chest in the Sunken village and get the Siegebreaker's Stone.

coordinates.title: Volatile Fragment
coordinates.description: Defeat Vrannic, the Grand Illusionist in the Hall of Illusions inside the Mushroom Village Gate Beacon to obtain the Volatile Fragment.

coordinates.title: Etching Needles
coordinates.description: This key item is found in a chest past the Tarblighted Shepherd just before the boss fight area for Magdalena, Lady of the Woods.

coordinates.title: Holding Cells
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found inside a well near the edge of the Blackridge Hamlet.

coordinates.title: Coward’s Retreat
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found along a rocky wall just east of the Blackridge Pass beacon.

coordinates.title: Deserted Mine
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found east of Mushroom Village if you go past the area where you meet Hilga and Grom.

coordinates.title: Magdalena’s Glade
coordinates.description: This beacon will spawn inside the Glutten Mire after you defeat Magdalena, Lady of the Woods.

coordinates.title: Troubadour’s Lute
coordinates.description: The Troubadour's Lute is found inside the One-Legged Wolf Tavern. It is located to the left of the performer facing the stage.

coordinates.title: Map of Fainweald 【2】
coordinates.description: This fragment can be found along the ramparts of the citadel on the top floor.

coordinates.title: Citadel of Penance
coordinates.description: This beacon will be found on the top floors of the Citadel of Penance. The easiest way to get here is to exploit the teleportation from the ruins north of the One Legged Wolf beacon.

coordinates.title: Grudge Stone
coordinates.description: The Grudge Stone can be looted from a chest near the Citadel of Penance beacon.

coordinates.title: Eredrim, The Venerable
coordinates.description: You can find Eredrim inside the boss area of the Citadel of Penance where you fight The Warden.

coordinates.title: Heart of Vatra
coordinates.description: Head to the Temple of Vatra, which is located northeast of the One-Legged Wolf Tavern. Once inside, continue heading north until you reach the end and collect the Heart of Vatra. Then, head back to the One-Legged Wolf Tavern, give the Heart of Vatra to Gragu, and play out the memory to obtain his shell.

coordinates.title: Gragu, The Insatiable
coordinates.description: Head to the Temple of Vatra, which is located northeast of the One-Legged Wolf Tavern. Once inside, continue heading north until you reach the end and collect the Heart of Vatra. Then, head back to the One-Legged Wolf Tavern, give the Heart of Vatra to Gragu, and play out the memory to obtain his shell.

coordinates.title: Corrupted Statue - Central Fainweald
coordinates.description: This corrupted statue is found in the center of Fainweald with the nearest beacon being the one in Mushroom Village.

coordinates.title: Grisha Hunting Grounds
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found northeast of the Mushroom Village beacon. It will be a hole in a rocky wall.

coordinates.title: Unyielding Stone
coordinates.description: The Unyielding Stone is obtained as a reward for cleansing the Corrupted Statue in Central Fainweald.

coordinates.title: Berserker’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Berserker's Stone can be found in a chest after making 3 offerings in the Temple of Vatra.

coordinates.title: Stonebled Gate
coordinates.description: This beacon can be found down inside a cave just before the Sanguine Caverns Gate, with a trail of blood leading to it.

coordinates.title: Nochtean Gate
coordinates.description: This gate is found at the very end of the Ruins of Nochte and is the first beacon to cleanse in order to enter the Prisoner's Domain.

coordinates.title: Outskirts of Nochte
coordinates.description: This beacon is found in the heart of The Hag's Path, south of the Citadel of Penance.

coordinates.title: Gloomshade Grove
coordinates.description: This beacon is found on a cliffside east of the Citadel of Penance.

coordinates.title: Sester’s Gate
coordinates.description: This beacon is found inside Sester's Refuge, past the Abbey Entrance. Follow the main path through the refuge and continue up the stairs until you reach the beacon.

coordinates.title: Gate of Infinity
coordinates.description: This beacon can be accessed by heading straight up the stairs from Ruk, where you obtained the Map of Mammon (2). Follow the path to the end to reach the beacon.

coordinates.title: Castigator’s Keep
coordinates.description: This beacon is found at the top of the Castigator's Keep ruins. From the entrance, head right and follow the stone stairs up.

coordinates.title: Abbey Entrance
coordinates.description: This beacon is found past the Outskirts of Mammon Beacon. Cross the Bone Gate and follow through the ruins until you find Abbey Entrance.

coordinates.title: Abandoned Outpost
coordinates.description: This beacon is found south of the bone gate connecting the Outskirts of Mammon to the Deserted Slums.

coordinates.title: Gate of Mammon
coordinates.description: This beacon is found on the southwestern tip of the map connected by a bone gate from the High Lord's Courtyard.

coordinates.title: High Lord’s Courtyard
coordinates.description: This beacon is southwest of the Abandoned Outpost in the Ruins of Mammon. This is also near the location of a Map Fragment.

coordinates.title: Hangman’s Scaffold
coordinates.description: This beacon is found at the top of the castle walls. From the central courtyard, topple the stone statue by shooting the gas-filled pots, then use it as a ramp to reach the upper wall. Follow the stairs and exit through the archway to find the beacon.

coordinates.title: Executioner’s Pulpit
coordinates.description: This beacon is found above the Prisoner's Pulpit area. From the Hangman's Scaffold Beacon, take the wooden stairs and follow the path across the wooden bridges and up the stone stairs. Continue past the Resolve Stalk and drop down at the end to reach the beacon.

coordinates.title: Slumwater Drain
coordinates.description: This beacon is hidden inside a sewer grate in the first room of the Slumwater Drain. From the entrance, head right and look for the broken grate beside the torch.

coordinates.title: Captive’s End
coordinates.description: This beacon appears after defeating the Nameless Captive. Enter the beacon that rises after the boss fight to collect the Ova.

coordinates.title: Pulsing Caves
coordinates.description: This beacon is found past the Pulsing Caves entrance. From the fork in the path, take the right path and follow it past the Lithopods to reach the beacon.

coordinates.title: Sanguine Shoreline
coordinates.description: This beacon is found inside the large cave past the two bridges. From the clearing, take the left bridge into the cave and follow the path until you reach the beacon.

coordinates.title: Child’s Feeding Grounds
coordinates.description: This beacon appears after defeating the Lost Child. Enter the beacon that rises from the ground to cleanse it.

coordinates.title: Ovate’s Chamber
coordinates.description: This beacon is found at the top of the elevator leading to Droeg's arena. After defeating Urrig, use the Jumping Pad and follow the path upstairs to the elevator.

coordinates.title: Winterglass Lake
coordinates.description: This beacon is found at the bottom of the large multi-level structure in Conquered Temple. Exit the structure and descend the three flights of stairs to reach the beacon.

coordinates.title: Conqueror’s Hoard
coordinates.description: This beacon is found after defeating Droeg, The Conquerer. Once Droeg is defeated, the Conqueror's Hoard emerges from the ground.

coordinates.title: Citadel Annex
coordinates.description: This beacon is found on a balcony past an egg-filled cave. Head up through the cave and climb the stairs on the other side until you reach the beacon.

coordinates.title: Citadel Atrium
coordinates.description: This beacon is found on the lower level of the room past the chained platform. From Solnir boss arena, take the elevator, use the Bone Gate to cross the gap, head left where you'll see a Canyon Crawler, and walk all the way down until you reach the beacon.

coordinates.title: Scholar-Prince’s Chamber
coordinates.description: This beacon is found inside Sir Isaac, the Scholar-Prince boss arena.

coordinates.title: Nameless Pass
coordinates.description: This beacon is found past the Cefatropod cave following the rocky ramp shortcut.

coordinates.title: Ossinite Falls
coordinates.description: This beacon is found just past the rocky hill after the room with the Grisha Hunters.

coordinates.title: Hexapod’s Burrow
coordinates.description: This beacon is found hidden in the mist inside the Hexapod boss arena.

coordinates.title: Disciple’s Grotto
coordinates.description: This is the second beacon you will activate during the Prologue.

coordinates.title: Village Outskirts
coordinates.description: This is the first beacon you will activate during the Prologue.

coordinates.title: Shattering Stone
coordinates.description: The Shattering Stone is found in a chest located inside the Collapsed Mine dungeon.

coordinates.title: Shrike Stone
coordinates.description: The Shrike Stone is found in a chest  within the Glutten Mire. In the wide area just before the Sunken Village beacon, find the alternate path leading to a wide area with a chest at the end.

coordinates.title: Barrage Stone
coordinates.description: The Barrage Stone is obtained as a reward for completing the trials of the Corrupted Statue found in the Gloomshade Grove.

coordinates.title: Muredean Actuator
coordinates.description: You'll find the Muredean Actuator inside a chest found in the Village Outskirts beacon.

coordinates.title: Shattered Beacon
coordinates.description: This beacon can be found north of the Blackridge Pass beacon guarded by an Infested Stalker.

coordinates.title: Overrun Quarry
coordinates.description: This dungeon can be found just north of the One-Legged Wolf beacon.

coordinates.title: Feeding Grounds
coordinates.description: This dungeon is unlocked by breaking three Golden Flower Tombstones at the Stones of Remembrance.

coordinates.title: Crumbling Tunnel
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found directly across from the Shattered Beacon dungeon where you can pick up Proxima's shell.

coordinates.title: The King’s Crypt
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found north of the Blackridge Pass beacon, past the Shattered Beacon dungeon.

coordinates.title: Ravaged Hideout
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found southeast of the Gloomshade Grove beacon. Its entrance is guarded by the Bloodcursed Lithopod.

coordinates.title: Holding Cells
coordinates.description: This dungeon is accessible once you defeat the Bloodcursed Lithopod boss guarding its entrance.

coordinates.title: Martyr’s Prison
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found to be located northwest of Gloomshade Grove Beacon. Northeast of the castle's outskirts

coordinates.title: Ravaged Tomb
coordinates.description: This dungeon is found directly below the Nochtean Gate beacon on the lower grounds of the ruins.

coordinates.title: Desolate Keep
coordinates.description: This dungeon located directly across from Sester Genessa in Marrow Keep. Reveal an Illusionary Wall for the dungeon entrance.

coordinates.title: Smuggler’s Hideout
coordinates.description: This dungeon can be found to the east of the Outskirts of Mammon beacon.

coordinates.title: Veteran’s Battle Axe
coordinates.description: The Veteran's Battle Axe is located on the lowest level of the King's Crypt and is guarded by a Tough Brigand.

coordinates.title: Salvaged Trebuchaxe
coordinates.description: Find the crevice at the end of the Ravaged Hideout and obtain the Salvaged Trebuchaxe from the kneeling corpse. Be careful, as enemies will ambush you from behind as you approach the corpse.

coordinates.title: Ballistazooka
coordinates.description: Head to Sentry's Grave, then make your way to the boss's room and defeat the Subjugated Guardian to obtain the Ballistazooka.

coordinates.title: Cursed Child
coordinates.description: Make your way to the flashing light in the middle of the Revered Beacon and attack it to reveal and obtain the Cursed Child.

coordinates.title: Triarch Repeater
coordinates.description: Proceed through the cavern until you reach an area with a broken wagon and the corpses of a human and a horse. The Triarch Repeater can be found on the ground in this area.

coordinates.title: Caged Hystrix
coordinates.description: Head to the Chamber of Becoming dungeon and defeat Sariel, the Endless. Then, climb the stairs past the boss arena and obtain the Caged Hystrix from the top.

coordinates.title: Axatana
coordinates.description: To get the Axatana, go to the teleporter in the eastern part of the map that leads to the Forgotten Tower. Keep going up the stairs and press the plate to open the gate. Defeat the Gloom Seeker in the room and take the Axatana near the candles.

coordinates.title: Obsidian Hammer
coordinates.description: To obtain the Obsidian Hammer, teleport to the Gate of Mammon beacon and head to the collapsed mine. Make your way through the mine and take the elevator to the Deserted Slums. Continue through the slums to reach the Obsidianite Mines. Go to the lowest level and defeat the Prophet of Profane Infinities to get the Obsidian Hammer.

coordinates.title: Clockwork Scythe
coordinates.description: To get the Clockwerk Scythe, head to the Chamber of Becoming dungeon, which is located in the southern part of the map. Defeat Sariel, the Endless, and you'll be able to get the Clockwerk Scythe upon his defeat.

coordinates.title: Black Needle
coordinates.description: Defeat the Stray Sesters in the Sester's Gate beacon to obtain the Black Needle.

coordinates.title: Great Martyr’s Blade
coordinates.description: The Great Martyr's Blade is inside Martyr's Prison, in a room blocked by a box.

coordinates.title: Naylshotte
coordinates.description: The Naylshotte is provided as part of the introductory tutorial.

coordinates.title: The Iconoclast
coordinates.description: The Iconoclast is provided as part of the introductory tutorial.

coordinates.title: Lazlo, The Justicar
coordinates.description: To obtain Lazlo, head to the Royal Crypt of Mammon, which is located in the southwest area of the map. Defeat Vellen, the High Lord of Mammon, and continue through the dungeon until you reach the crypts. Follow the torch-lit path to find Lazlo's shell, which you can obtain after playing through his memory.

coordinates.title: Sariel, The Endless
coordinates.description: To get Sariel, head to the Chamber of Becoming dungeon, which is located in the southern part of the map. Defeat Sariel, the Endless. You will then be able to interact with his corpse, play out his memory, and obtain the shell.

coordinates.title: Smert, The Apostate
coordinates.description: To get Smert, start by head into Prophet's Rest and interacting with the middle circle to trigger the Blood Offering, which will cause you to lose your shell. Use the enemies scattered around the area to regain your shell, then do the same with the circle on the right. Once all blood offerings are glowing red, interact with Smert's corpse to view his memory and obtain it.

coordinates.title: Justiciar’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Justiciar's Stone can be found on a shrine near where a swarm of Broodshell Snails will attack you.

coordinates.title: Gloombound Stone
coordinates.description: The Gloombound Stone can be found in a chest in the Stones of Remembrance.

coordinates.title: Corrupted Statue - Gloomshade Grove
coordinates.description: This corrupted statue can be found past the Blackridge Pass beacon as you make your way to the west.

coordinates.title: Fulminant Stone
coordinates.description: This Fulminant Stone can only be bought from the Night Merchant, an NPC that only appears when you are in Night mode. Accessing Night mode requires the Gloombound Flame from the Great Arbiter of Flesh boss area.

coordinates.title: Infested Stone
coordinates.description: The Infested Stone can only be bought from the Night Merchant, an NPC that only appears when you are in Night mode. Accessing Night mode requires the Gloombound Flame from the Great Arbiter of Flesh boss area.

coordinates.title: Weeping Stone
coordinates.description: The Weeping Stone can only be bought from the Night Merchant, an NPC that only appears when you are in Night mode. Accessing Night mode requires the Gloombound Flame from the Great Arbiter of Flesh boss area.

coordinates.title: Infused Stone
coordinates.description: The Infused Stone can only be bought from the Night Merchant, an NPC that only appears when you are in Night mode. Accessing Night mode requires the Gloombound Flame from the Great Arbiter of Flesh boss area.

coordinates.title: Clerik’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Clerik's Stone is found in a chest behind a secret hidden wall in the Ruins of Nochte. This chest will be near a cliff's edge.

coordinates.title: Tyrant’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Tyrant's Stone is found in a chest behind a secret hidden wall in the Sester's Abbey.

coordinates.title: Map of Mammon【5】
coordinates.description: This map fragment can be found just south west of the Outskirts of Mammon beacon.

coordinates.title: Colossus Stone
coordinates.description: The Colossus Stone is found in a chest in the Silent Steps, north of the Parasitic Stash dungeon.

coordinates.title: Warden’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Warden's Stone is obtained as a reward for defeating Urrig the Executioner, a boss near the Winterglass Lake beacon in the Conquered Temple Gate.

coordinates.title: Serpent Stone
coordinates.description: The Serpent Stone is obtained as a reward for defeating Lucian the Thirsting Knight in the Stonebled Gate beacon.

coordinates.title: Blackblood Stone
coordinates.description: The Blackblood Stone is obtained inside the Mawbreak Cavern, a dungeon found when you cleanse the Pulsing Caves beacon in the Sanguine Caverns Gate.

coordinates.title: Bulwark Stone
coordinates.description: The Bulwark Stone can be found in a chest located at the end of a broken bridge at the south end of the Citadel of Penance.

coordinates.title: Confessor’s Keepsake
coordinates.description: The Confessor's Keepsake is obtained as a reward for defeating Tishina's Confessor just before reaching the Executioner's Pulpit beacon inside the Prisoner's Domain gate.

coordinates.title: Captive’s Scabstone
coordinates.description: The Captive's Scabstone is obtain after defeating the Nameless Captive boss inside the Prisoner's domain.

coordinates.title: Rupturing Stone
coordinates.description: The Rupturing Stone is found inside a chest just above the boss area where you fight the Nameless Captive in the Prisoner's Domain.

coordinates.title: Curseblood Stone
coordinates.description: The Curseblood Stone is obtained as a reward for defeating the Gloombound Wraith, a boss in the Forbidden Archives, the dungeon within the Gate of Infinity beacon.

coordinates.title: Map of Mammon【6】
coordinates.description: This map fragment can be found right across from the High Lord's Courtyard beacon.

coordinates.title: Voltaic Amber
coordinates.description: The Voltaic Amber is obtained as a reward for defeating the Starved Harridan boss at the Vestige of Infinity, south of the Castigator's Keep beacon.

coordinates.title: Map of Fainweald【1】
coordinates.description: This map fragment is found just north of the Outskirts of Nochte beacon in The Hag's Path

coordinates.title: Hag Stone
coordinates.description: The Hag Stone is found in a chest at the end of the Infested Den, a dungeon inside the Outskirts of Nochte beacon accessible when you enter the beacon.

coordinates.title: Duality Stone
coordinates.description: The Duality Stone is found in a chest at the end of the Ravaged Tomb dungeon in the Ruins of Nochte.

coordinates.title: Voltaic Crown
coordinates.description: The Voltaic Crown is obtained as a reward for defeating Vrago, Solikar Champion, the boss of the Nochtean Gate beacon when you cleanse it.

coordinates.title: Clockwork Shardstone
coordinates.description: The Clockwork Shardstone is found in a chest at the very end of the Alchemist's Workshop dungeon.

coordinates.title: Enfeebling Stone
coordinates.description: The Enfeebling Stone is obtained as a reward for completing the combat trial of the Corrupted Statue in the Outskirts of Mammon.

coordinates.title: Corrupted Statue - Outskirts of Mammon
coordinates.description: This statue is found just east of the Outskirts of Mammon beacon, above the Hag's Pit dungeon.

coordinates.title: Gloombound Flame
coordinates.description: This candle can be found on a pillar near where the Great Arbiter of Flesh boss area in Widow's Overlook.

coordinates.title: Hand of Rock
coordinates.description: The Hand of Rock can be bought from the Barkeep at the One-Legged Wolf Tavern.

coordinates.title: Citadel Gate Lever
coordinates.description: This item drops from the Bloodcursed Lithopod, a boss that hides in front of the Ravaged Hideout dungeon.

coordinates.title: Crypt Key
coordinates.description: This item can be found within the Desolate Peak. Look inside the dungeon entrance, the key will be on top of a table.

coordinates.title: Deadeye Stone
coordinates.description: The Deadeye Stone can be found by opening a chest surrounded by Brigands in the Sanguine Caverns.

coordinates.title: Special Moonshine
coordinates.description: You can get this item from a crate across from Baghead in the Desolate Peak just by the entrance to the dungeon.

coordinates.title: Ironpiercer’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Ironpiercer's Stone is found in a chest located in the upper levels of the Central Sewers dungeon near the Executioner's Pulpit beacon.

coordinates.title: Poisoned Dagger
coordinates.description: The Poisoned Dagger is given by Gorf after you help him by giving him Weltcaps. This dagger is to be given to Hilga near the Mushroom Village Beacon.

coordinates.title: Lost Clotstone
coordinates.description: The Lost Clotstone is obtained as a reward for defeatingThe Lost Child, the final boss of the Sanguine Caverns Gate, found in the Child's Feeding Grounds.

coordinates.title: Tarred Fragment
coordinates.description: The Tarred Fragment is obtained as a reward for defeating the Tarblighted Stoner, the boss of the Sanguine Caverns Gate.

coordinates.title: Myriad Stone
coordinates.description: The Myriad Stone  is found in a chest in the Feeding Grounds dungeon. First find the Crypt Key  in The Desolate Peak to access this dungeon.

coordinates.title: Scholar’s Wormstone
coordinates.description: The Scholar's Wormstone is obtained as a reward for defeat Sir Isaac, the Scholar-Prince, the final boss of the Faded Citadel Gate.

coordinates.title: Accursed Stone
coordinates.description: The Accursed Stone is obtained from a chest found inside the Abandoned Outpost when you cleanse the beacon.

coordinates.title: Charged Stone
coordinates.description: The Charged Stone is obtained from a chest in the Nameless Pass beacon when you cleanse it.

coordinates.title: Conquerer’s Reward
coordinates.description: The Conqueror's Reward is obtained as a reward for defeating Droeg, the Conqueror, the final boss of the Conquered Temple Gate.

coordinates.title: Devout Stone
coordinates.description: The Devout Stone is found in a chest located in the Sester's Refuge.

coordinates.title: Frostshard Stone
coordinates.description: The Frostshard Stone can be obtained from a chest located at the very end of the Conqueror's Hoard beacon when you cleanse it.

coordinates.title: Fusillade Stone
coordinates.description: The Fusillade Stone can be obtained as a reward for defeating the Caged Grisha boss inside the Winterglass Lake beacon in the Conquered Temple Gate.

coordinates.title: Headman’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Headman's Stone is found in a chest in the Outskirts of Mammon.

coordinates.title: Hexapod Core
coordinates.description: The Hexapod Core is obtained as a reward for defeating the Hexapod, the final boss of the Withered Shoals Gate, in the Hexapod's Burrow.

coordinates.title: Inflamed Clawstone
coordinates.description: The Inflamed Clawstone is obtained as a reward for defeating the Rabid Grisha Pack, a dungeon boss of the Holding Cells.

coordinates.title: Monarch’s Vestige
coordinates.description: The Monarch's Vestige is obtained as  a reward for defeating Bor the Deluded Monarch inside the Abbey Entrance beacon.

coordinates.title: Nightgrasp Stone
coordinates.description: The Nightgrasp Stone is obtained from a chest found near the Abbey Entrance beacon. The chest will only open after three offerings have been made by lighting the candles in the area.

coordinates.title: Pulse Stone
coordinates.description: The Pulse Stone can be obtained from chest located near the Winterglass Lake beacon inside the Conquered Temple Gate.

coordinates.title: Shuddering Stone
coordinates.description: The Shuddering Stone can be found in a chest inside the Illusionist's Cache, a dungeon in The Desolate Peak.

coordinates.title: Solnir Shard
coordinates.description: The Solnir Shard can be obtained as a reward for defeating Solnir the Gloomseeker, a boss found when you cleanse the Citadel Annex beacon.

coordinates.title: Spite Stone
coordinates.description: The Spite Stone is obtained from a chest found inside the Bellkeeper's Corner dungeon near the Abandoned Outpost beacon.

coordinates.title: Splitting Stone
coordinates.description: The Splitting Stone can be obtained from a chest in the Lonesome Spire, the building found on the east of the Gate of Mammon beacon.

coordinates.title: Squall Stone
coordinates.description: The Squall Stone is obtained from a chest found inside the Executioner's Pulpit beacon inside the Prisoner's Domain Gate.

coordinates.title: Stillblade’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Stillblade's Stone can be looted from a chest found inside the Citadel Annex beacon when you cleanse it.

coordinates.title: Strange Remnant
coordinates.description: The Strange Remnant can be obtained as a reward for defeating the Strange Grisha in the Withered Shoals Gate.

coordinates.title: Summoning Stone
coordinates.description: The Summonning Stone can be looted from a chest in the Ashen Sanctum, an area you can access when you enter the Faded Citadel gate.

coordinates.title: Thief’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Thief's Stone is obtained as a reward for clearing the Corrupted Statue in the Vestige of Infinity.

coordinates.title: Torpor Stone
coordinates.description: The Torpor Stone can be looted from a chest found near the Ossinite Falls beacon in the Withered Shoals gate.

coordinates.title: Unstable Stone
coordinates.description: The Unstable Stone can be looted from a chest located west of the Castigator's Keep beacon.

coordinates.title: Viletongue Hedron
coordinates.description: The Viletongue Hedron can be obtained as a reward for defeating the Viletongue Batushka, the boss at the end of the Castigator's Keep when you cleanse it.

coordinates.title: Wretchcaller’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Wretchcaller's Stone is obtained as a reward for defeating the Infested Miner, a boss found at the end of the Gate of Mammon beacon when you cleanse it.

coordinates.title: Zealot’s Stone
coordinates.description: The Zealot's Stone is obtained as a reward for clearing the Besieged Ruins dungeon found to the east of the High Lord's Courtyard.

coordinates.title: Corrupted Statue - Vestige of Infinity
coordinates.description: This corrupted statue is found in the Vestige of Infinity in the southernmost region of the world map.

coordinates.title: Corrupted Statue - Revenant Graves
coordinates.description: This corrupted stateue can be found on the northeast tower of the Revenant Graves.
